designPhilosophy: A playful, soft, and alive creative companion workspace (inspired by family.co) where AI agent rules are visualized as friendly tool badges. The visual language features ultra-soft rounded corners, friendly off-whites, organic shapes, active color swatches, and a cute, breathing AI character with animated facial expressions that react dynamically to rule snaps.

distinctiveMoves: Breathing, animated AI companion character with cute eyes and expressive faces that react to actions.
Soft rounded cards with generous padding, gentle drop-shadows, and organic border paths.
Playful drag-and-snap rule badges (e.g. Clean Code, Safe Security, Fast Queries) that fit onto the AI agent.
Vibrant organic color highlights (Soft Blue, Coral Orange, Leafy Green) with rounded theme selector swatches.
Simple, warm, human-centric copywriting that explains complex technical benefits using common terms.

officialDocsRequiredFor: Framer motion dragging offsets and face morphing
Dynamic HTML5 Canvas smooth particle systems
Tailwind-free soft box shadows and organic borders

designExecutionHandoff.primaryExperienceGoal: Deliver an exceptionally friendly, playful, and premium active companion workspace that instantly captures the general public's interest through warm colors, cute characters, and responsive snap features.

surfacePlan.goal: A striking asymmetric layout featuring a friendly companion panel on the left (with Outfit headers, setup pills, warm copy) and an interactive snapping game on the right (dragging soft rule badges onto a cute, breathing AI Agent with reaction expressions).
Soft-rounded, friendly cards (like family.co bento cells) styled as cute inspector properties with generous padding and warm details.

visualResetStrategy.resetComposition: Resets physical synthesizers or coordinate grids to a spacious, playful interactive designer desk board with friendly character expressions.
visualResetStrategy.resetMotion: Resets gravity patch cables and canvas waveform monitors to soft breathing companion shapes, snapping rules badges, and smiling morphing expressions.
visualResetStrategy.regressionTestSafety: Passed. The new visual scheme contains zero residual attributes, files, or parameters of the synthesizer drafting or technical specs blueprint theme.
